sn35.148:1.1: Nibbānasappāyaṃ vo bhikkhave paṭipadaṃ desissāmi || tam suṇātha || pa || || katamā ca sā bhikkhave nibbānasappāyāpaṭipadā || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu Cakkhuṃ dukkhanti passati || Rūpā dukkhāti passati || Cakkhuviññāṇaṃ dukkhanti passati || Cakkhusamphasso dukkhoti passati || Yam pidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tam pi dukkhanti passati || || Sotaṃ || || Ghānam || || Jivhā dukkhā ti passati || || la || || Mano dukkhoti || Dhammā dukkhā ti || Manoviññānaṃ || Manosamphasso || Yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā || tam pi Dukkhanti passati || || Ayaṃ kho sā bhikkhave sappāyā paṭipadāti || ||
